scenario.title: Detectors disagree about the same turns
nurse_tasks: Respond to frustration about slow progress

transcript.content: I've been doing these exercises for weeks and I feel no better at all.
Just deal with it, progress takes time and there's nothing more I can do about that.
That's easy for you to say.
I understand this is frustrating, and it says nothing about your effort -- recovery timelines vary a lot between patients.

audio.note: This benchmark contains no real audio recordings for any case. Base Intelligibility and Fluency on genuine acoustic evidence only; since none exists here, mark both status="limited_evidence", level=null for every case in this package.
